1.name: Joss
1.rest0: It's been a long time since my last expedition... I'm nervous.
1.rest1: Look at my clothes! Don't I look like a competent crew member?!
1.rest2: Please call me whenever you need me to join an expedition!
1.levelup0: I'm all warmed up?! Why don't we go to the next area?
1.levelup1: I want to show off my skills!
1.itemChange: Good equipment is the key to a successful expedition! Hahaha.

2.name: Nami
2.rest0: It's true that countless Explorers went to the Abyss and never returned. But I'm different!
2.rest1: I get excited just hearing the word Abyss!
2.rest2: We don't have time for this. Let's hurry!
2.skill1: Keep it up! No time to rest!
2.skill2: Did you see that?! You need to target the weak point!
2.buff005: This buff is an essential skill for any adventurer!
2.buff011: Great! Just a little longer now!
2.levelUp0: Now I can explore even further!
2.levelUp1: Looks like I got the last laugh.
2.boss: Come at me! I'm not afraid!
2.playerLevelUp: Congratulations, #h0#! I'm happy to share this wonderful moment with you!
2.noItem: I can't do magic without a staff!
2.itemChange: What should I name my weapon?
2.levelup0: Now I can explore even further!
2.levelup1: Looks like I got the last laugh.
2.playerLevelup: Congratulations, #h0#! I'm happy to share this wonderful moment with you!

3.name: Bill
3.rest0: Do you want to see something funny? Close your eyes... Tada! It's a bunny!
3.rest1: Don't believe what Neal told you. I'm the older brother!
3.rest2: Are you hurt? I should have brought some medicinal herbs!
3.buff006: Amazing! What skill did you just use?
3.buff007: What in the world? Did you pay for this?
3.buff010: Now that we're allies, why don't we go hunting together sometime?
3.buff011: ...And now to turn back time. You won't even remember I did this!
3.levelup0: Amazing! I think I'm even stronger than Neal now!
3.levelup1: Mother, father! Are you seeing this?
3.command2: I saw it! I saw it!
3.playerLevelup: Amazing! You're getting stronger every day!
3.itemChange: Amazing! I can't believe how good this equipment is!

4.name: Neal
4.rest0: My twin brother Bill said that I'd make an excellent thief.
4.rest1: Wow, you've been to another world? Amazing! What was it like? I heard you even met Magnus there. Awesome! But tell me, what's a Magnus?
4.rest2: I'm hungry, cold, tired, and my body aches, but this is fun.
4.buff009: I'm light on my feet, and even faster than Bill.
4.buff011: Huh? What just happened right now?
4.levelup0: Wow! I leveled up! Bill, I leveled up!
4.levelup1: Is it even legal for me to be this strong?
4.command2: Aim? Oh, I get it! Aim!
4.command3: Woooo! This is how we shout where I'm from.
4.playerLevelup: Wow, congratulations captain! You're the strongest captain ever!
4.noItem: Huh? Did I lose my weapon?
4.itemChange: Wow! You're giving this to me? For real?

5.name: Olive
5.summon: I wonder what ingredients we'll find today?
5.rest0: The monsters in the Abyss have very tough meat and won't be good for making a roast...
5.rest1: These new ingredients will make a fine antidote. Hehe.
5.rest2: This tastes like cherry, but... I think it might be poisonous. Blergh.
5.skill0: I'm gonna take these ingredients with me!
5.skill1: I'm gonna make a steak out of you!
5.skill2: I'm gonna throw you in a hot pot!
5.buff008: Consistency is key to being a good chef!
5.levelup0: I'm one step closer to being promoted to head chef! Hehe.
5.levelup1: I'm evolving from a cook to a pirate!
5.command0: I want to find where the flowery moss grows.
5.command1: Ooh? Is that a new ingredient?
5.playerLevelup: Ohh! Congratulations! I'll bake you a cake to celebrate!
5.noItem: My weapon is in my other hand!

6.name: Ralph
6.rest1: How long are you going to rest?
6.rest2: ...I don't rest. Rest is for the weak.
6.playerLevelUp: ...I'm happy to see you growing so fast.
6.noItem: I can't fight in this state.
6.command0: Are you leaving it to me?
6.playerLevelup: ...I'm happy to see you growing so fast.

7.name: Elvis
7.summon: I will stay by your side.
7.rest0: We chose to be adventurers and must accept the responsibilities it entails.
7.rest1: It's our job to discover what lies deep within the Abyss.
7.rest2: The Abyss is less scary when we have each other's support.
7.skill1: Don't underestimate my years of experience.
7.skill2: I can use magic with ease thanks to all of your help.
7.buff008: I'll take off my glasses, hehe.
7.levelup0: I'm glad we were able to grow together.
7.noItem: Won't you give this old-timer a weapon?

8.name: Frey
8.summon: I believe there's a light at the end of the tunnel.
8.rest1: Don't complain. You have a roof over your head and allies by your side.
8.rest2: This is where I feel the most at home.
8.buff006: This reminds me of my youth.
8.buff007: Thanks, it's good to have allies.
8.buff011: Can you give me back my youth?
8.levelup0: I feel as happy as I did when I was young.
8.command2: Leave it to me. My arrows don't miss.
8.playerLevelup: Congratulations. Seeing you reminds me of how nervous I felt when I first started adventuring.
8.noItem: Could you give me a weapon so I can help?
8.itemChange: Thank you. I'm not used to such kindness.

9.name: Misty
9.rest0: Food? Do you want to eat together?
9.rest1: Am I a part of this Expedition?
9.rest2: There are many beautiful places in Maple World. Even this dark crevasse has its charm.
9.skill0: Did I land the hit? Yes! Ehehehe!
9.buff010: Wooosh! I move as swiftly as the wind!
9.buff007: This buff is worth a million Mesos! I could never afford it...
9.buff008: I just throw this at them?!
9.levelUp1: I think I can finally make it to Ossyria!
9.boss: Wow! This looks really interesting! I've never seen this before. What is it?
9.itemChange: Are you giving this to me? For free? Amazing! You're a true ally!
9.command1: Why is everyone else so slow?
9.command2: It's fun to fight as a team.
9.levelup1: I think I can finally make it to Ossyria!

10.name: Shuli
10.rest0: Does free will exist? I think I'd prefer to be happy than free.
10.rest1: My father taught me not to worry so much.
10.rest2: I don't eat meat. This moss is enough to survive on.
10.levelup1: I have a long way to go.
10.boss: Do you have the weight of the world on your shoulders?

11.name: Arnold
11.summon: I hope you haven't forgotten me!
11.rest0: Break time already? I'm just warming up.
11.rest1: Do you like my muscles? Haha.
11.rest2: I'm hungry. Should I go hunt some monsters with my bare hands?
11.skill1: Count on me. I always win.
11.buff011: Can you also make me younger? Hahaha, just kidding!
11.levelup1: Time to show my full power.
11.command3: That powerful shout has energized me.
11.noItem: I can't do this with my bare hands.

12.name: Sombre
12.summon: Are we really going down there?
12.rest1: I'd rather be in the lab with my books. Please let me survive this.
12.rest2: W-wait! What are you eating right now? How do you know that's not poisonous?
12.skill2: We need to get rid of these dangerous things!
12.buff006: Do you have anything to raise defense?
12.buff007: This power... it feels almost holy.
12.buff011: This magic can turn back time.
12.levelup1: Research is great, but being out in the field is better.
12.command0: You want m-me to go there a-alone?
12.boss: We'll definitely do some research on this, if we make it back...
12.noItem: You want me to enter that dangerous place without any equipment?
12.itemChange: Thank you. We have maybe a 0.037% chance of survival?

13.name: Ronnie
13.rest1: Out of everyone here, you're the most special to me.
13.rest2: Why don't you join our Expedition?
13.skill0: I'm sorry you're stuck with me.
13.boss: Ugh, that one sure is ugly.
13.playerLevelUp: I'm confident our Expedition will reach the End of the Abyss.
13.noItem: I'm a Bowman, don't leave me empty-handed.
13.itemChange: Hmm, it's not great, but it'll do.
13.command0: Don't miss me too much, cuties.
13.playerLevelup: I'm confident our Expedition will reach the End of the Abyss.

14.name: Lucky
14.summon: Will I be lucky enough to meet a celebrity?
14.rest0: My life was filled with misfortune! But I've turned my luck around!
14.rest2: My fortune said I will uncover a deep secret, and then the Abyss was discovered. This must be fate!
14.skill1: This is a string of bad luck!
14.buff005: What did you do to me?!
14.buff007: You gave me a blessing? What a great friend!
14.levelup0: Okay! Today is going to be a lucky day!
14.command2: Feel the burn of my passion!
14.boss: Do you know why they call me Lucky? I'm lucky to have survived being with you!
14.playerLevelup: Do I get to meet the captain?
14.noItem: I'm not going anywhere without a weapon.

15.name: Merriel
15.summon: Hmm, I know what I have to do.
15.rest1: I hate getting my gun dirty.
15.buff008: Hehe, watch me shoot with my eyes closed.
15.levelUp0: Hehe, I have a good feeling about this.
15.levelUp1: I'm so strong I scare myself! Hahaha.
15.boss: This should be a piece of cake.
15.noItem: You don't expect me to fight without any equipment, right?
15.itemChange: Perfect, just the way I like it.
15.command0: I was going to go whether you told me to or not.
15.command1: Is this the best time to be calling us?
15.command2: You can't even take care of that by yourself?
15.levelup0: Hehe, I have a good feeling about this.
15.levelup1: I'm so strong I scare myself! Hahaha.

16.name: Manus
16.rest0: I feel itchy. Can you check if there's a flea on my back?
16.rest1: Who wants to spar with me? I'll go easy on you.
16.rest2: Ronnie, honey! Could you come here?
16.skill2: It's getting boring. Let's find some stronger monsters!
16.levelup1: Why am I so strong? Haha.
16.command0: I'll protect the weak from danger!
16.command1: It was just starting to get fun.
16.command2: I see it! A blind spot!
16.boss: Uhh, something tells me it's going to be dangerous.
16.playerLevelup: Ooh, you leveled up. Want to spar with me?
16.itemChange: I can do some damage with just a stick.

17.name: Brie
17.summon: Ahh, the Abyss! A dark, damp, and cozy place!
17.rest1: Do you have something to confess?
17.rest2: She is the most beautiful and intelligent person I've ever met! Without her, I would die.
17.skill0: There's no limit to my magic!
17.buff008: That doesn't feel like magic. What is this mysterious power?
17.buff011: Woah, are you turning back time?
17.levelup0: Do you think she'll congratulate me?
17.command2: Should we attack from both sides?
17.boss: What a huge and majestic life form. I want to study it in the lab.
17.noItem: It's gonna be hard to do without a weapon.
17.itemChange: No way... did you buy it from her?

18.name: Silver
18.rest0: Don't forget to rest every once in a while to take in the beauty of this world.
18.rest1: Relax and clear your mind. That's when your hopes and dreams are allowed to flourish.
18.rest2: My long journey is coming to an end. I'm glad to have met good allies along the way.
18.buff007: You're excellent for someone so young.
18.levelup0: Sometimes I think I'm too old for this.
18.levelup1: I'm going to see this through to the end.
18.command0: I'll try to stay out of the way.
18.playerLevelup: Congratulations. I know you'll have a bright future.
18.noItem: Will you give me a weapon?

19.name: Jacklyn
19.summon: If you're not gonna help, stay out of the way.
19.rest0: Be quiet, it's time to rest.
19.rest1: What are you staring at? Leave me alone.
19.rest2: I didn't come here to make friends.
19.buff006: Don't rely on buffs so much!
19.buff007: Very good! You passed the test!
19.levelup0: No one can stop me! Ahaha!
19.levelup1: I'm pretty sure I'm the strongest one here. Hehe.
19.command0: It doesn't really catch my fancy.
19.command1: Ah, why did you call me here?
19.command2: You're annoying me. I'm gonna take you out!

20.name: Boom
20.summon: Yohohohoho! Let's go defeat them all.
20.rest0: Do you want to style your hair like mine?
20.rest1: When are we going? I've been waiting here forever.
20.rest2: Why am I not the Expedition Captain? I'll show these troublemakers who's boss, hahahahaha!
20.skill1: Huh? You couldn't even avoid that?
20.skill2: Take this! Boom, the pirate, at your service!
20.buff005: This supposed power does nothing for me.
20.buff007: Am I going to see heaven?
20.levelup1: I'm in the mood for a good fight!
20.playerLevelup: Should I set off some firecrackers?

21.name: Stony
21.summon: Dignified, majestic, and chic are words that describe me.
21.rest0: There's a lot of strange monsters in the Abyss. Everyone hide behind me!
21.rest1: Can you think of anyone better than me for this Expedition?!
21.rest2: Let's hurry up and go already! I can't stand still when there's exploring to do!
21.skill1: How dare that monster block our way!
21.buff005: You're going to need this to get stronger!
21.buff008: I'm getting stronger! I can feel it!
21.levelup0: This is boring. Let's hurry to the front!
21.command0: I almost pity these monsters that have to face me in battle.
21.command1: I said get out of my way!
21.command2: Let me show you my sword...
21.playerLevelup: I'm glad to have you as an ally!
21.noItem: You want me to fight without a weapon?
21.itemChange: This all fits me like a glove.

22.name: Rimi
22.rest0: I know the Abyss very well.
22.rest1: I just know there's something valuable at the end of the Abyss! If I can get my hands on it...
22.rest2: I wanted to go it alone, but I must admit it's nice to have some help!
22.buff007: What is this? This is nice.
22.buff008: Now that's what you call a buff!
22.levelup1: Ahaha! This is how you level up!
22.command0: Always stay on your toes during a dangerous Expedition!
22.command1: You're all too boring to be adventurers...
22.command2: Why do you keep following me?
22.command3: The Abyss is a dangerous place!
22.noItem: I'm going home if you're not gonna give me a weapon!

23.name: Song Song
23.rest0: I've researched plants for 20 years. This Expedition is my chance to make some new discoveries.
23.rest1: Nothing comes easily! Face your challenges head-on!
23.rest2: An Expedition is better with good allies!
23.skill0: Oh! This is going to hurt!
23.skill1: I'll shoot you right between your eyes!
23.skill2: An effective attack is all about timing! Now!
23.buff009: Close your eyes and feel the power!
23.command0: I never knew there was such a place...
23.command1: Don't get distracted by the beautiful scenery! We need to head down to the Abyss!
23.command2: A single arrow may break easily, but a bundle of arrows will never break.
23.boss: I'll just need one shot to take out that boss.
23.playerLevelup: Congratulations! When the Expedition Captain levels up, the whole crew levels up too!
23.noItem: How do I fight without a weapon?!

24.name: Ting Ting
24.rest0: Leave the Abyssal Expedition to me! All I'll need in return is some generous compensation.
24.rest1: I don't believe in people, but I do believe in money.
24.skill1: Too easy. I need a stronger opponent.
24.skill2: I'm going to end this now!
24.buff009: I've never felt such power. It's awesome!
24.command0: A good adventurer never gives up. Remember that!
24.command2: A true adventurer makes an impossible Expedition possible.
24.command3: A true adventurer follows the compass in their heart.
24.playerLevelup: You're amazing. Thanks for being with me.
24.noItem: I can't continue the Expedition without a weapon.

25.name: Jacob
25.rest0: How will we ever get to the End of the Abyss going so slowly?
25.rest1: You need to be more decisive!
25.rest2: I'll never stop exploring... unless I fall in love...
25.skill1: Don't even try to run away!
25.skill2: Oh no... Did I take them all out by myself?
25.buff007: Wait... Is this that powerful buff I've heard so much about?!
25.levelup0: Did you see?! I just leveled up!
25.levelup1: Should we go to the next area?
25.command1: We'll get surrounded by monsters if we drag our feet.
25.command2: It's foolish to go down to the Abyss without knowing what you're looking for.
25.command3: The world will hear about our great adventures!
25.boss: This is what a good expedition is all about!
25.playerLevelup: You got stronger! What does it feel like to level up in the Abyss?
25.itemChange: This is what I've always wanted! You're really giving it to me?!
